summary: Add --parallel N (default 1): bounded ThreadPoolExecutor over the pure function, single writer thread owning the connection, progress/outcome counters and --resume semantics preserved; needs 6950de58

resolution.note: --parallel N (default 1) added to build_parser/main/run_tagging; N<=1 keeps the exact serial loop, N>1 runs a bounded ThreadPoolExecutor (max_in_flight=N*2) over tag_one_chunk with the main thread as sole DB writer; --delay is a per-worker sleep (documented in --delay help + _tag_one_chunk_then_delay docstring); 8 new tests (parallel path, resume, bounded concurrency, worker-exception resilience, counter parity with serial), full suite 634 passed
